# Stackademic — "15 Python Scripts to Automate Your Daily Tasks"

- **Source:** https://blog.stackademic.com/15-python-scripts-to-automate-your-daily-tasks-8be2102c92e3
- **Type:** Blog/listicle summarizing small automation examples

Summary
-------
Article-style list of 15 small automation scripts (file renaming, reminders, screenshot-to-text, email automation, download helpers). Good as a short reading checklist for beginners and for generating small exercises for onboarding.

Why this is useful
-------------------
- Compact checklist of approachable scripts to implement as hands-on tasks for new contributors.
- Helpful to map simple learning exercises to canonical implementations in larger repos (e.g., map "file renamer" to `wasmerio/Python-Scripts` example).

Risks / Caveats
---------------
- The blog may redirect to Medium; content availability can change.

Suggested Local Actions
-----------------------
1. Save a short local summary and map each listed script to a canonical implementation in `wasmerio-Python-Scripts` or `awesome-scripts`.
2. Optionally create a small workshop notebook that implements 3 of the scripts as exercises for onboarding.
